title: Effect of Telitacicept on Antibody Titers in Primary APS Patients
off: A Single Center, Randomized Controlled, Open Label Trial Exploring the Regulatory Effect of Telitacicept on Antibody Titers in Primary Antiphospholipid Syndrome Patients Carrying High-risk Antiphospholipid Antibody Profiles
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the regulatory effect of Telitacicept on antibody titers in primary antiphospholipid syndrome patients carrying high-risk antiphospholipid antibody profiles.
desc: This is a single center, randomized controlled trial in Ruijin Hospital. The enrolled patients will be randomized in a 1: 1 ratio to receive either SOC+Telitacicept or SOC treatment.Telitacicept is administered subcutaneously at a dose of 160mg once a week for 48 weeks.

arms.d: Telitacicept 160mg once a week for 48 week as an add-on treatment regimen. SOC treatment includes aspirin and/or vitamin K antagonists (VKA) and/or low molecular weight heparin.
SOC treatment includes aspirin and/or vitamin K antagonists (VKA) and/or low molecular weight heparin.

primary.m: The proportion of patients with decreased aPL titer at week 48 of treatment
